source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion: Verify the water test prior to the construction inspection. 3. Be aware that the water test is for the entire water supply system, not just for the new, completed plumbing system. 4. Do everything possible to prevent water contamination. 5. Calibrating a septic System 6. What to do If you think that the water is contaminated Start with the inspection records. Begin your analysis with the plumbing inspection record or repair order. If this step is not specifically required by your city, be prepared to prove an adequate supply of water for the work to be inspected or the damage or loss of water resulting from the work being inspected. It is important to note that, for some cases, there were no city plumbers working on the day the water was tested and so the plumbing wasn’t the cause of the failed test. In other words, even if the city plumber could not connect the water supply system to the municipal water supply
